about_short_description.short_description: Nova Benefits is an employee wellness platform that offers health insurance plans for employees and their families.

product.name: Group Health Insurance
product.description: Customised group health insurance plans providing financial coverage for employees and their families, including coverage for pre-existing conditions and no waiting periods.

product.name: Super Top-Up Health Insurance
product.description: An additional health insurance plan that provides coverage beyond the base group health insurance sum insured, activating after the base policy is exhausted.

product.name: Group Covid Insurance
product.description: Group insurance policy covering medical expenses related to COVID-19 treatment for employees and their families.

product.name: Employee Wellness Benefits
product.description: A suite of wellness services including teleconsultations, fitness subscriptions, mental health support, and health check-ups to complement insurance coverage.

identifier.value: Employee Benefits Platform (Portal and Mobile App)

product.name: Employee Benefits Platform (Portal and Mobile App)
product.description: A technology platform enabling employees and HR to manage health insurance and wellness benefits, including claims, policy details, and wellness event registrations.
